nets: PWM1 series node to J3 pin 3
anomalies.observed: R3 in the PWM1 path (between the PWM1 net and J3 pin 3) is annotated 1M (1 MΩ). The matching series resistor R4 on the PWM2 path is 1k.
anomalies.expected: The specification states R3 and R4 are 1 kΩ each, series resistors from the PWM1/PWM2 GPIO nets to J3 pin 3 and J8 pin 3.

evidence.quote: | R3, R4 | 1k each | Series resistors from the PWM1/PWM2 GPIO nets to J3 pin 3 / J8 pin 3 respectively. |
R3 with value 1M in the PWM1 branch, next to R4 with value 1k in the PWM2 branch (upper-left servo section of the sheet, around J3 and J8)

anomalies.impact: A 1 MΩ series resistor in the PWM1 path would essentially open the channel-1 signal to the pan/foot servo at J3. The servo would receive no usable PWM pulses, while channel 2 works normally, so the two channels would behave asymmetrically.

parsed.summary: The schematic annotates R3, the PWM1 series resistor to J3 pin 3, as 1 MΩ, while the specification and the matching R4 call for 1 kΩ. This would break the channel-1 PWM signal to the servo, so the verdict is an anomaly.
